opponent.label: Velvet
opponent.description: Once a perfect example of a kind, loving young woman who cared deeply for her family, a traumatic event involving the loss of her brother and a betrayal shattered her world. Now transformed into a Therion, a being that can devour other living beings for their power, she has become a fierce and aggressive person who is nearly consumed by her quest for vengeance. Though, she cannot fully bury her true self.
